name: Baby names in England and Wales 1996 to 2025 (Office for National Statistics)
copyright: Office for National Statistics, United Kingdom
note: Every name given to a baby in England and Wales from 1996 to 2025, by sex and year.

A birth cohort rather than a living population, unlike Spain, Poland and Finland. The
weights describe who is under thirty in England and Wales, which is the right shape for
most fixtures and the wrong one for anything modelling the whole population.
Serves `en_GB`, which until now inherited the American-weighted list through `en`.
Counts of one or two are withheld as `[x]` under the personal-information exemption.
